title: Live Odoo object graph and discovery contract
summary: Hosted Odoo records are projected as live ooRexx objects with dynamic methods, typed local discovery policy, relation traversal, live queries, events and provider-wide weak identity.
invariants: Remote schema is evidence; executable ooRexx source is never downloaded from Odoo.
discovery.operation is the local authority for which remote operations may become callable.
UNKNOWN is a bootstrap mechanism: discovered methods are installed with setMethod and normal dispatch takes over.
A provider-wide WeakReference identity map canonicalises one live OdooObject per model/id while allowing garbage collection.
many2one reads materialise OdooObject; one2many/many2many reads materialise live collections; collection writes fail closed unless explicit Odoo command semantics are declared.
Live queries retain surviving object identity and emit ADDED, REMOVED and UPDATED membership events.
procedure: Use provider~modelSpace or provider~model(name) for model discovery.
Use browse/search/searchRead/liveQuery to obtain canonical OdooObjects.
Use performDiscovery to refresh schema/method surfaces and update/refresh to merge remote changes.
Translate only locally declared typed operations such as messagePost into JSON-2 keyword arguments.
